name: jarvis-knowledge-interface
description: A local-first personal knowledge interface for Notion, semantic graph exploration, and focused daily context.

scripts.dev:web: npm run prepare:fonts && WRANGLER_LOG_PATH=.wrangler/wrangler.log vinext dev
scripts.desktop:prepare: npm run build && npm run desktop:sidecar
scripts.desktop:dev: npm run desktop:prepare && node scripts/run-tauri.mjs dev
scripts.desktop:check: node scripts/run-cargo.mjs fmt --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml -- --check && node scripts/run-cargo.mjs check --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml
scripts.desktop:build: npm run desktop:setup && node scripts/run-tauri.mjs build --bundles app,dmg
scripts.build: npm run prepare:fonts && WRANGLER_LOG_PATH=.wrangler/wrangler.log vinext build
scripts.test:integration: npm run build && npm run test:integration:built
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test:unit && npm run test:integration
